decision_cruda.rationale:
The radio and the CMMS agree that LH-01 (C564-14) and LH-02 (C512-06) are down, with likely repairs of 4 h and 5 h, so no confirmation is needed. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 12:00 and can't be used. Both stopes still have broken ore and a mine stockpile with room. Central's stockpile is 174 of 450 t, and 4 trucks are hauling. Only LH-08 and LH-09 can lend, because both are on development headings. Mining stopes in carguio phase have more valuable output than the oz lost by pulling a loader. Development costs 1.0 oz/h for DS-N522-01 and 1.5 oz/h for DS-C564-02.

LH-09 to TJ-C564-14: it is on the same level, so travel is about 0.34 h. 134 t of broken ore remain at 12.1 g/t. An LH410 at 120 m moves about 29 t/h, which is 11.3 oz/h. After the 1.5 oz/h development cost that is about 9.8 oz/h, or about 38 oz over roughly 3.9 h.

LH-08 to TJ-C512-06: travel is about 0.7 h. 272 t of broken ore remain at 9.2 g/t. An LH410 at 80 m moves about 30.9 t/h, which is 9.1 oz/h. After the 1.0 oz/h development cost that is about 8.1 oz/h, or about 35 oz over roughly 4.3 h.

I chose this pairing because it matches the shorter travel to the higher-grade stope. The swapped pairing nets the same per hour but has longer travel. I did not use LH-07 or the other stope loaders, since their own production would be lost. The loans end when the repairs finish, which the layer handles. Net after travel is about 65 oz.
